### Epistemologiia jäne syni bağalau

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about knowledge concern what can be believed responsibly, what makes claims true, and when confidence should change. This domain applies general standards of justification to testimony and public information; scientific experimental design has its own domain.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senımnıñ negızdı boluyna ne äser etetının jäne qoğamdyq aqparatty qalai bağalau keregın zertte.

#### Dälelder men kuälıkter

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Knowledge often depends on information supplied by other people or institutions. Source reliability, independence, and evidential fit require appraisal without treating every source as equally trustworthy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Basqalar jetkızgen tūjyrymdar men dälelderdı bağalaudy üiren.

##### Epistemikalyq ädıletsızdıktı taldau

[analyzeEpistemicInjustice.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/analyzeEpistemicInjustice.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how prejudicial credibility judgments or unequal interpretive resources can wrong someone in their capacity as a knower, distinct from warranted critical assessment of testimony.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senımdılıkke ädıletsız bağa beru adamdardyñ dauysy estılmeuıne qalai äkeletının zertte.

##### Derekközder arasyndağy rastaudy tekseru

[checkCorroborationAcrossSources.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/checkCorroborationAcrossSources.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether apparently agreeing accounts are genuinely independent or reproduce one underlying report.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır-bırımen kelısetın bırneşe derekköz şynymen täuelsız dälel ūsyna ma, sony tekser.

##### Tūjyrym men onyñ dälelın ajyratu

[distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate what someone asserts from the observations, documents, or arguments presented to support it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūjyrymnyñ özın ony qoldau üşın berılgen aiğaqtardan ajyrat.

##### Tıkelei dälel men estu arqyly jetken mälımettı ajyratu

[distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize what a record or witness directly establishes and what depends on another person's retelling.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bastapqy jazbalardy özgeler qaitalağan tūjyrymdardan ajyrat.

##### Kuälıktıñ senımdılıgın bağalau

[evaluateTestimonialCredibility.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/evaluateTestimonialCredibility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the speaker's opportunity to know, relevant competence, track record, and possible conflicts without reducing evaluation to popularity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kuäger ne sarapşynyñ tiıstı täjıribesı men yqtimal müddeler qaqtyğysyn esker.

#### Bılım jäne negızdeu

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Belief, truth, evidence, and knowledge have distinct roles in epistemic evaluation. Competing theories of knowledge can disagree about exactly how those roles connect.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senım, aqiqat, dälel men bılımnıñ özara bailanysy men aiyrmasyn bıl.

##### Matematikalyq däleldeudı negızdeu retınde taldau

[analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine why deductive proof has a distinctive epistemic role in mathematics, distinguishing formal derivability from experimental confirmation and acknowledging debates about proof's explanatory value.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Matematikalyq däleldeu täjıribeden alynğan aiğaqtardan nelıkten erekşelenetının zertte.

##### Apriorlyq jäne empirikalyq negızdeudı salystyru

[compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish support based primarily on reasoning from support requiring experience, without assuming the boundary is universally uncontested.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oilauğa süiengen bılım men täjıribege süiengen bılımdı salystyr.

##### Senım men bılımdı ajyratu

[distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that sincerely accepting a proposition does not by itself establish that it is known, even when the speaker is confident.

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a claim might be true for reasons its holder cannot supply, or well supported yet ultimately false.

[evaluateReasonsForABelief.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/evaluateReasonsForABelief.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether offered grounds actually bear on the proposition and withstand plausible objections.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keltırılgen sebepter senımdı şynymen qoldai ma, sony tekser.

#### Media jäne qoğamdyq aqparat

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Information environments combine reporting, interpretation, promotion, and falsehood. Epistemic evaluation concerns the warrant for public claims, not the psychological mechanics by which messages persuade audiences.

#### Belgısızdık jäne skeptitsizm

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/index.ts)

### Etika jäne moraldyq paiymdau

Groups: 5 · Skills: 25

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/index.ts)

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Normative theories emphasize different criteria of moral assessment. A theory is not a universal formula that automatically resolves every difficult case.

[applyConsequentialistReasoning.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/applyConsequentialistReasoning.ts)

[applyDutyBasedReasoning.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/applyDutyBasedReasoning.ts)

[compareEthicalFrameworksOnOneDilemma.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/compareEthicalFrameworksOnOneDilemma.ts)

#### Metaetika

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inquiry into the meaning, objectivity, and epistemic standing of moral discourse underlies but does not itself prescribe codes of conduct. Normative theories decide how to act; metaethical theories examine the status of such judgments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moraldyq tūjyrymdardyñ mänın jäne moraldyq aqiqat jeke senımderge täueldı me, sony zertte.

[analyzeMoralDisagreement.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/analyzeMoralDisagreement.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether disputants differ about facts, principles, or the status of moral claims, and what kinds of reasons could address those differences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Faktıler jönındegı kelıspeuşılıktı moraldyq ölşemder jönındegı kelıspeuşılıkten ajyrat.

##### Moraldyq realizm men antirealizmdı salystyru

[compareMoralRealismAndAntiRealism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/compareMoralRealismAndAntiRealism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess opposing views about whether moral truths exist independently of attitudes, and distinguish this ontological disagreement from practical moral choices.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Obektivtı moraldyq aqiqatty moiyndaityn jäne joqqa şyğaratyn közqarastardy salystyr.

##### Metaetikalyq jäne normativtık sūraqtardy ajyratu

[distinguishMetaethicalFromNormativeQuestions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/distinguishMetaethicalFromNormativeQuestions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate questions about which actions are right from questions about what moral claims mean and whether their truth is objective.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nenıñ dūrys ekenı turaly sūraq pen moraldyq paiymnyñ mänı turaly sūraqty ajyrat.

##### Moraldyq kognitivizm men nonkognitivizmdı ajyratu

[distinguishMoralCognitivismFromNonCognitivism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/distinguishMoralCognitivismFromNonCognitivism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether moral utterances express truth-apt beliefs or instead function as prescriptions, commitments, or other attitudes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moraldyq söilemder faktını bıldıre me, älde ūstanym men mındettemenı körsete me, zertte.

##### Moraldyq reliativizmdı bağalau

[evaluateMoralRelativism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/evaluateMoralRelativism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test the view that moral truth or justification varies by culture or individual against cases involving disagreement, criticism, and reform.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dūrys pen būrys mädenietke ne jeke közqarasqa täueldı me, zertte.

##### Moraldyq uäjdemenı zertteu

[examineMoralMotivation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/examineMoralMotivation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare philosophical positions on whether sincerely judging an act right necessarily motivates someone to perform it, without substituting a psychological causal theory.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır närsenı dūrys dep senu mındettı türde äreketke itermelei me, oilan.

#### Moraldyq ūğymdar

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ethical claims use concepts such as duty, harm, intention, and virtue that cannot be reduced to personal approval.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mındet, niet, ziian jäne moraldyq jauapkerşılık siiaqty ūğymdardy ajyratudy üiren.

##### Moraldyq mındettı taldau

[analyzeMoralDuty.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/analyzeMoralDuty.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify what it means to hold that a person is obligated to act even when doing so is inconvenient.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moraldyq mındettı oryndau qolaisyz bolsa da, nege ol küşınde bolatynyn tüsın.

##### Niet pen saldardy ajyratu

[distinguishIntentionsFromConsequences.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/distinguishIntentionsFromConsequences.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why an action's aim and its actual effects may be evaluated separately in moral reasoning.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärekettıñ közdelgen maqsaty men saldaryn bölek bağala.

##### Moraldyq jäne moralğa qatysy joq paiymdardy ajyratu

[distinguishMoralFromNonMoralJudgments.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/distinguishMoralFromNonMoralJudgments.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim concerns obligations or rights rather than taste, etiquette, prudence, or mere legality.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Etikalyq tūjyrymdardy jeke talğamnan, ädepten jäne qūqyqtyq normalardan ajyrat.

##### Moraldyq jäne sebeptık jauapkerşılıktı ajyratu

[distinguishMoralResponsibilityFromCausalResponsibility.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/distinguishMoralResponsibilityFromCausalResponsibility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate causing an outcome from being appropriately accountable for it under relevant knowledge and control conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır närsenıñ sebebı bolu men moraldyq kınäğa laiyq boludy ajyrat.

#### Moraldyq oi elegınen ötkızu

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Difficult cases require identifying who is affected, which reasons conflict, and whether an apparent compromise respects relevant obligations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Etikalyq oilar qaişy kelgende, qiyn tañdaulardy paiymdaudy üiren.

##### Moraldyq şeşımderdegı proportsionaldyqty bağalau

[assessProportionalityInMoralDecisions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/assessProportionalityInMoralDecisions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider whether a harmful burden or restriction is justified in relation to its aim and less harmful alternatives.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ziian ne şekteuler negızdelgen maqsatqa sai ma, bağala.

##### Moraldyq qarsy däleldı bağalau

[evaluateAMoralCounterargument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/evaluateAMoralCounterargument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test whether an objection exposes an overlooked harm, inconsistency, or relevant exception to a principle.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ziian, erekşelık ne qaişylyqtardy aşatyn qarsy pıkırlerdı qarastyr.

##### Qaişy keletın moraldyq mındetterdı anyqtau

[identifyConflictingMoralObligations.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/identifyConflictingMoralObligations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify duties or values that cannot all be fully honored in a concrete case without assuming that all conflicts are irresolvable.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ekı etikalyq mındettı bır uaqytta tolyq oryndau mümkın bolmaityn jağdailardy tany.

##### Etikalyq dilemmadağy müddelı taraptardy anyqtau

[identifyStakeholdersInAnEthicalDilemma.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/identifyStakeholdersInAnEthicalDilemma.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize persons or other morally relevant parties affected directly or indirectly by a proposed choice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moraldyq tañdaudan äser alatyn barlyq adam men özge taraptardy anyqta.

##### Moraldyq paiymdy negızdeu

[justifyAMoralJudgment.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/justifyAMoralJudgment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a normative conclusion to stated values, principles, and case facts rather than mere personal preference.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moraldyq paiymdy aiqyn qağidalarmen jäne tiıstı faktılermen negızde.

### Filosofiia tarihy men dästürlerı

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Historically situated philosophical arguments develop through schools, intellectual movements, and traditions across cultures. Interpretation requires understanding both what a thinker argued and the debate that shaped the argument, without privileging one lineage as philosophy's default.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Türlı mädeniet pen däuırdıñ filosofiialyq ideialaryn olardyñ dälelderı arqyly zertte.

#### Filosofiialyq dästürler

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Intellectual traditions developed across many cultures through original arguments and sustained exchanges. Greek, Indian, Chinese, Islamic, African, Latin American, and particular Indigenous lineages are examined as philosophical sources in their own right, without treating a region as a single doctrine.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı mädeni dästürlerde qalyptasqan filosofiialyq dälelderdı zertte.

##### Qytai filosofiialyq dästürınıñ dälelın taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAChineseTradition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAChineseTradition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position in a specific Chinese philosophical lineage, such as Confucian or Daoist thinking, without conflating them.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qytai dästürındegı pıkırdı onyñ tiıstı konteksınde tüsındır.

##### Latyn Amerika dästürındegı filosofiialyq däleldı taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reconstruct an argument from a specific Latin American current, such as liberation or decolonial philosophy, in its intellectual and social context without reducing the region to one doctrine.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Latyn Amerika filosofiialyq dälelderın äleumettık jäne ziiatkerlık kontekstınde zertte.

##### Afrika filosofiialyq dästürınıñ dälelın taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine a representative argument concerning persons, community, knowledge, or values while avoiding claims that Africa has a single philosophy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Naqty bır Afrika dästürınıñ filosofiialyq dälelın talda.

##### Ündı filosofiialyq dästürınıñ dälelın taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndianTradition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndianTradition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims and reasons in a specific Indian philosophical school while preserving its distinctive terms and internal disagreements.

##### Baiyrğy halyq filosofiiasynyñ dälelın taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndigenousTradition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndigenousTradition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret philosophical claims from a particular Indigenous people or intellectual tradition on their own conceptual terms, recognizing differences among communities and avoiding a generic 'Indigenous worldview'.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baiyrğy halyq dästürınıñ ideialaryn öz mänmätınınde qarastyr.

##### İslam filosofiialyq dästürınıñ dälelın taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain a selected debate in Islamic philosophy using its intellectual context rather than assuming theology and philosophy are identical.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İslam filosofiiasyndağy pıkırtalasty tarihi mänmätınde zertte.

##### Klassikalyq grek filosofiiasy täsılderın salystyru

[compareClassicalGreekPhilosophicalApproaches.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/compareClassicalGreekPhilosophicalApproaches.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative methods or commitments in Socratic, Platonic, and Aristotelian arguments without collapsing them into one doctrine.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sokrat, Platon jäne Aristotel ideialaryn salystyr.

[comparePositionsAcrossPhilosophicalTraditions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/comparePositionsAcrossPhilosophicalTraditions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a genuine shared problem and meaningful conceptual differences without forcing one tradition's categories onto another.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı dästürlerdıñ ūqsas filosofiialyq sūraqtardy qalai qarastyratynyn salystyr.

#### Filosofiialyq eñbekterdı oqu

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Texts require interpreting claims, their argumentative context, and the questions the author sought to answer; historical wording cannot always be mapped directly to modern categories.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Filosofiialyq eñbekterdı olardyñ sūraqtary men mänmätının eskere otyryp oqudy üiren.

##### Filosofiialyq mätındı syni bağalau

[evaluateAPhilosophicalTextCritically.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/evaluateAPhilosophicalTextCritically.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess reasons offered in a source rather than accepting or rejecting a view solely because of the author's reputation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Klassikalyq mätınnıñ dälelderın bağala, tek avtor bedelıne süienbe.

##### Filosofiialyq mätınnıñ basty mäselesın anyqtau

[identifyTheCentralProblemInAPhilosophicalText.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/identifyTheCentralProblemInAPhilosophicalText.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine which issue motivates an argument rather than treating every illustrative passage as the main thesis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Filosof şeşuge tyrysqan negızgı mäselenı anyqta.

##### Filosofty tarihi mänmätınde tüsındıru

[interpretAPhilosopherInHistoricalContext.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/interpretAPhilosopherInHistoricalContext.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use contemporaneous debates and available concepts to avoid attributing later assumptions to an earlier author.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Filosofiialyq közqarastardy öz däuırındegı pıkırtalastarmen bailanystyra tüsındır.

##### Tarihi filosofiialyq däleldı qaita qūrastyru

[reconstructAHistoricalPhilosophicalArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/reconstructAHistoricalPhilosophicalArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Extract claims and reasons from a source while distinguishing a philosopher's stated position from later summaries.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Däleldı filosoftyñ naqty jazğanyna süienıp qalpyna keltır.

#### Filosofiialyq mektepter men ağymdar

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophical movements and schools arise around distinctive approaches to knowledge, reason, liberty, and existence; their boundaries and internal disagreements cannot be reduced to dates alone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı filosofiialyq mektepterdıñ ortaq sūraqtardy qalai qarastyratynyn zertte.

[analyzeAnEnlightenmentPhilosophicalArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/analyzeAnEnlightenmentPhilosophicalArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Place a claim about reason, liberty, or authority in its intellectual context while acknowledging diverse and conflicting Enlightenment positions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aqyl, bilık pen erkındık turaly Ağartuşylyq dälelderın zertte.

##### Ekzistentsialistık jäne analitikalyq täsılderdı salystyru

[compareExistentialistAndAnalyticApproachesToAProblem.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/compareExistentialistAndAnalyticApproachesToAProblem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify differences in methods and questions without claiming that either broad family has one uniform answer.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ekı dästürdıñ eşqaisyn şamadan tys qarapaiymdatpai salystyr.

##### Qazırgı epistemologiianyñ negızgı täsılderın salystyru

[compareMajorModernEpistemologicalApproaches.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/compareMajorModernEpistemologicalApproaches.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the distinct emphases of rationalist, empiricist, and critical traditions through representative arguments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ratsionalizm, empirizm jäne syni filosofiianyñ bılımdı tüsındıruın salystyr.

### Logika jäne däleldeu

Groups: 6 · Skills: 35

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The central question is whether reasons support a conclusion and in what way. Formal entailment, defeasible inference, and argumentative defects are distinguished from psychological causes of belief, which belong chiefly to Psychology.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Negızder qorytyndyny qoldai ma, sony bağalaudy jäne qate paiymdaudy tanudy üiren.

#### Däleldeudegı qateler

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A flaw concerns the relation between claims and reasons, not necessarily the speaker's motives or a named cognitive bias. Context matters: surface wording alone rarely proves fallaciousness.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūjyrymdardy qoldaityn uäjderdegı jiı kezdesetın qatelerdı tanudy üiren.

##### Jalğan dilemmany anyqtau

[detectAFalseDilemma.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/detectAFalseDilemma.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a purported exhaustive choice that overlooks meaningful alternatives or combined possibilities.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aldamşy «ne būl, ne anau» tañdauynan jasyrylğan mañyzdy balamalardy tap.

##### Saban adam dälelın anyqtau

[detectAStrawManArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/detectAStrawManArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where a position is distorted into an easier target and recover the actual view before evaluating it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bıreudıñ ūstanymy şabuyldauğa oñai bolu üşın būrmalansa, baiqa.

##### Jeke basqa tiısu qatesın anyqtau

[detectAnAdHominemFallacy.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/detectAnAdHominemFallacy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a personal attack substitutes for addressing reasons, while distinguishing relevant credibility evidence from irrelevant insults.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke basqa şabuyl oryndy däleldeudı almastyrğan sättı tany.

##### Söz mağynasyn auystyru qatesın anyqtau

[detectAnEquivocationFallacy.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/detectAnEquivocationFallacy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace a shift between meanings of the same expression that makes an inference appear stronger than it is.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dälel barysynda sözdıñ mağynasy auysqanyn baiqa.

##### Ainalmaly paiymdaudy anyqtau

[detectCircularReasoning.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/detectCircularReasoning.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when the offered support presupposes the very claim at issue without independent justification.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Däleldeuge tiıs qorytyndyny aldyn ala şyn dep qabyldaityn dälelderdı tany.

##### Bedelge süienudı bağalau

[evaluateAnAppealToAuthority.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/evaluateAnAppealToAuthority.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether expertise is relevant and reliable evidence in context, rather than assuming that invoking any authority proves a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keltırılgen sarapşylyq pıkır oryndy dälel me, älde avtomatty rastau emes pe, anyqta.

#### Dälelder men qorytyndy şyğaru

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Arguments connect propositions through an inferential claim; assertions, explanations, and rhetorical appeals may occur nearby without playing the same role.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Alğyşarttar men qorytyndy qalai dälel qūraitynyn bıl.

##### Dälel men tüsındırmenı ajyratu

[distinguishAnArgumentFromAnExplanation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/distinguishAnArgumentFromAnExplanation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Tell reasoning intended to establish a claim from an account of why an already accepted event or fact occurred.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır närsege senu negızın qabyldanğan faktını tüsındıruden ajyrat.

##### Däleldıñ qorytyndysyn anyqtau

[identifyAnArgumentsConclusion.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/identifyAnArgumentsConclusion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine which proposition is supposed to follow or gain support, regardless of its position in a passage.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dälel negızdeuge tyrysatyn negızgı tūjyrymdy anyqta.

##### Däleldıñ alğyşarttaryn anyqtau

[identifyPremisesInAnArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/identifyPremisesInAnArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate the reasons offered in support of a conclusion, including unstated propositions when context makes them indispensable.

##### Däleldı standartty türde qaita qūru

[reconstructAnArgumentInStandardForm.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/reconstructAnArgumentInStandardForm.ts)
