#### Deduktivtı paiymdau

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Deduction concerns whether it is possible for premises to be true while a conclusion is false. Logical form is evaluated separately from whether the premises describe the world correctly.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qorytyndy berılgen alğyşarttardan qaşan mındettı türde şyğatynyn zertte.

##### Modus ponens erejesın qoldanu

[applyModusPonens.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/applyModusPonens.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a consequent from a conditional and its antecedent without treating the inverse conditional as equivalent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erejenı qoldan: A-dan B şyqsa jäne A şyn bolsa, B de şyğady.

##### Modus tollens erejesın qoldanu

[applyModusTollens.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/applyModusTollens.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reject the antecedent of a conditional from the denial of its consequent, under the conditional as stated.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şartty tūjyrym men onyñ saldaryn terısteu arqyly alğyşartty terıste.

##### Deduktivtı jaramdylyqty bağalau

[assessDeductiveValidity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/assessDeductiveValidity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a conclusion must hold if the premises hold, using logical structure rather than agreement with the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Barlyq alğyşart şyn bolyp, qorytyndy jalğan boluy mümkın be, tekser.

##### Jaramdylyq pen negızdılıktı ajyratu

[distinguishValidityFromSoundness.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/distinguishValidityFromSoundness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a sound deductive argument requires both a valid inference and true premises.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Logikalyq jaramdy dälelde de jalğan alğyşarttar nege boluy mümkın ekenın tüsın.

##### Kategoriialyq sillogizmdı bağalau

[evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether relations among classes support the proposed conclusion, rather than relying on familiar subject matter.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sanattar turaly tūjyrymdar qorytyndyny logikalyq türde qoldai ma, anyqta.

##### Tūjyrymdar jiynyndağy qaişylyqty anyqtau

[identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where commitments cannot all be true together under the same meanings and conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bırdei jağdaida bärı bır mezgılde şyn bola almaityn tūjyrymdardy tany.

#### Deduktivtı emes paiymdau

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Many reasonable arguments support conclusions without guaranteeing them. Their strength depends on evidence, alternatives, sampling, or explanatory power rather than formal certainty.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Anyqtyqqa kepıl bermese de, qorytyndyny qoldaityn paiymdaudy bağalaudy üiren.

##### Deduktivtı anyqtyq pen yqtimaldyq qoldaudy ajyratu

[distinguishDeductiveCertaintyFromProbabilisticSupport.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/distinguishDeductiveCertaintyFromProbabilisticSupport.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a well-supported conclusion can remain revisable when the reasoning is non-deductive.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Logikalyq mındettı qorytyndyny tek yqtimaldyq qoldaityn qorytyndydan ajyrat.

##### İnduktivtı jalpylaudy bağalau

[evaluateAnInductiveGeneralization.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/evaluateAnInductiveGeneralization.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how well observed cases support a claim about a broader population, including the relevance of selection and variation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baqylanğan mysaldar keñırek jalpylaudy qanşalyqty qoldaitynyn bağala.

##### Üzdık tüsındıruge qarai qorytyndylaudy bağalau

[evaluateAnInferenceToTheBestExplanation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/evaluateAnInferenceToTheBestExplanation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare hypotheses by how well they explain evidence, their assumptions, and their fit with alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dälelder men boljamdarğa süienıp, yqtimal tüsındırmelerdıñ bırın tañda.

##### Ūqsastyq boiynşa paiymdaudy bağalau

[evaluateAnalogicalReasoning.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/evaluateAnalogicalReasoning.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether compared cases share features relevant to the proposed conclusion rather than merely superficial similarities.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jağdailardy qorytyndyğa şyn mänınde mañyzdy ūqsastyqtarmen salystyr.

#### Predikattar logikasy

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Variables and quantifiers permit reasoning about individuals and collections. The relevant universe and scope of each quantifier must be made explicit to evaluate meaning and inference.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kvantorlar toptağy barlyq ne keibır müşeler jaily pıkırdı qalai bıldıretının zertte.

##### Kvantordyñ äreket aiasyn taldau

[analyzeTheScopeOfAQuantifier.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/analyzeTheScopeOfAQuantifier.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which variables and expressions are governed by a quantifier and how scope changes the meaning of a formula.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kvantordyñ orny pıkırdıñ mağynasyn qalai özgertetının anyqta.

##### Predikattar men pıkırlerdı ajyratu

[distinguishPredicatesFromPropositions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/distinguishPredicatesFromPropositions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a predicate with an unbound variable as an open expression and a proposition as a statement with specified truth conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ainymalysy bar aşyq örnektı tolyq pıkırden ajyrat.

##### Kvantorlarmen qorytyndylaudy bağalau

[evaluateAnInferenceWithQuantifiers.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/evaluateAnInferenceWithQuantifiers.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether a conclusion about all or some members of a domain follows from quantified premises under a stated interpretation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kvantorlary bar alğyşarttar ūsynylğan qorytyndyny şynymen tuyndata ma, tekser.

##### Bar bolu kvantoryn tüsındıru

[interpretExistentialQuantification.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/interpretExistentialQuantification.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine what it means for at least one element of a specified domain to satisfy a property, without implying uniqueness.

**User-friendly description (kk):** «Bar» degenı şartqa sai kemınde bır mysal bar ekenın tüsın.

##### Jalpylyq kvantoryn tüsındıru

[interpretUniversalQuantification.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/interpretUniversalQuantification.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine what it means for a property to hold for every element of a specified domain and how one counterexample would matter.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı toptyñ ärbır müşesıne qatysty pıkırdı tüsın.

##### Kvantorly pıkırdı terısteu

[negateAQuantifiedProposition.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/negateAQuantifiedProposition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the relationships between not-all and some-not, and between none and there-exists, to interpret negation accurately.

**User-friendly description (kk):** «Barlyq» nemese «keibır» sözderı bar pıkırlerdı mağynasyn būzbai terıste.

#### Pıkırler logikasy

Skills: 9

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Truth-functional connections between propositions determine the logical properties of compound statements. Symbolic operators and truth tables clarify implications independent of the subject matter used in examples.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Logikalyq amaldarmen bailanysqan pıkırlerdıñ şyndyq şarttaryn zertte.

##### Pıkırdı şyndyq kestesımen jıkteu

[classifyAPropositionUsingATruthTable.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/classifyAPropositionUsingATruthTable.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish tautological, contradictory, and contingent expressions through their truth values under all assignments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şyndyq kestesımen ärqaşan şyn, ärqaşan jalğan jäne jağdaiğa täueldı pıkırlerdı ajyrat.

##### Şyndyq kestesın qūru

[constructATruthTable.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/constructATruthTable.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Enumerate truth-value combinations for atomic propositions and systematically compute outcomes of logical expressions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Logikalyq örnektıñ barlyq mümkın şyndyq mänderınıñ kestesın qūr.

##### Atomarlyq jäne kürdelı pıkırlerdı ajyratu

[distinguishAtomicFromCompoundPropositions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/distinguishAtomicFromCompoundPropositions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposition can stand alone or form part of a statement built with logical connectives; truth-functional structure differs from the number of words in an ordinary sentence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dara pıkırdı logikalyq jalğaulyqtardan qūralğan kürdelı pıkırden ajyrat.

##### Logikalyq ekvivalenttılıktı tüsındıru

[interpretLogicalBiconditional.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/interpretLogicalBiconditional.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess 'if and only if' statements as two-way conditional relationships, rather than treating either one-way conditional as sufficient.

**User-friendly description (kk):** «Sonda jäne tek sonda» ekı bağytta da implikatsiiany talap etetının tüsın.

##### Logikalyq koniunktsiiany tüsındıru

[interpretLogicalConjunction.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/interpretLogicalConjunction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the truth conditions of logical 'and' while distinguishing conjunction from a chronological or causal relationship.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Logikalyq «JÄNE» pıkırı qaşan şyn bolatynyn tany.

##### Logikalyq diziunktsiiany tüsındıru

[interpretLogicalDisjunction.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/interpretLogicalDisjunction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the truth conditions of inclusive 'or' and distinguish these from interpretations that require exactly one alternative.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qamtuşy «NEMESE» amalyn ekı nūsqa da şyn boluy mümkın ekenın eskerıp tüsın.

##### Logikalyq terısteudı tüsındıru

[interpretLogicalNegation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/interpretLogicalNegation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when the denial of a proposition is true and distinguish negation from a stronger contrary statement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūjyrymdy terısteu onyñ şyndyq şarttaryn qalai özgertetının tüsın.

##### Materialdyq implikatsiiany tüsındıru

[interpretMaterialImplication.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/interpretMaterialImplication.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when a conditional is true in classical propositional logic without confusing logical implication with causation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Klassikalyq pıkırler logikasynda şartty pıkır qaşan şyn bolatynyn tüsın.

##### Deduktivtı jaramdylyqty şyndyq kestesımen tekseru

[testDeductiveValidityUsingATruthTable.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/testDeductiveValidityUsingATruthTable.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Search for a case in which all premises are true but the conclusion false to determine propositional validity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Alğyşarttar şyn, qorytyndy jalğan bolatyn jağdaidy ızdep, deduktsiiany tekser.

### Metafizika

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysics examines the most general categories of reality, such as what exists, how things persist, and what makes events possible. Its conceptual questions differ from describing particular natural mechanisms in the sciences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bolmys, bıregeilık, şyndyq, uaqyt jäne mümkındık turaly filosofiialyq sūraqtardy zertte.

#### Sebeptılık, uaqyt jäne mümkındık

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysical inquiry asks what causal dependence means and how temporal or modal claims relate beyond specific measurements.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sebep, uaqyt jäne boluy mümkın oqiğalar turaly filosofiialyq közqarastardy qarastyr.

##### Uaqyt turaly filosofiialyq közqarastardy salystyru

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences between views that privilege the present and views treating past, present, and future as equally real.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tek osy şaq şynaiy degen pıkırdı barlyq uaqyt bırdei şynaiy degen pıkırmen salystyr.

##### Sebeptılıktı uaqyttyq rettılıkten ajyratu

[distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that one event occurring before another does not itself establish a productive or counterfactual dependence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erterek bolğan oqiğa keiıngınıñ mındettı türde sebebı bolmaidy.

##### Mümkındık pen qajettılıktı ajyratu

[distinguishPossibilityFromNecessity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/distinguishPossibilityFromNecessity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims that could be otherwise and those held to be true in every relevant possible circumstance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Boluy mümkın närse men mındettı türde aqiqat bolatyn närsenı ajyrat.

##### Kontrfaktılık tūjyrymdy bağalau

[evaluateACounterfactualClaim.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/evaluateACounterfactualClaim.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine what would follow if specified conditions had differed while keeping relevant background assumptions coherent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qiialdağy basqa jağdailarda ne boluy mümkın ekenın bağala.

#### Bolmys jäne sanattar

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different theories posit concrete objects, properties, events, or abstract entities; their classification determines what kinds of ontological commitments a claim makes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Filosoftar şynaiy dep esepteitın ärtürlı närselerdı qarastyr.

##### Naqty jäne abstraktılı mänderdı ajyratu

[distinguishConcreteFromAbstractEntities.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/distinguishConcreteFromAbstractEntities.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a proposed entity has spatial or causal features characteristic of concrete things or is treated as abstract, such as a mathematical object.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Fizikalyq zattardy sandar ne dereksız ideialar siiaqty mänderden ajyrat.

##### Qasietter men nysandardy ajyratu

[distinguishPropertiesFromObjects.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/distinguishPropertiesFromObjects.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a bearer from qualities attributed to it, while recognizing that some metaphysical theories analyze this distinction differently.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nysannyñ özın oğan telıngen qasietterden ajyrat.

##### Bolmys turaly tūjyrymdy bağalau

[evaluateAnExistenceClaim.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/evaluateAnExistenceClaim.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the criteria by which something is said to exist rather than assuming that naming it settles its ontological status.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır närsenıñ bar ekenın qandai dälel ne paiym negızdeitının sūra.

#### Bıregeilık jäne uaqyt boiy saqtalu

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about sameness arise when material, properties, or relations change over time. Numerical identity is different from merely sharing characteristics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özgerse de bır närse qalai sol küiınde qalatynyn oila.

##### Metafizikalyq paradoksty taldau

[analyzeAMetaphysicalParadox.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/analyzeAMetaphysicalParadox.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify apparently plausible assumptions that generate inconsistent conclusions in a puzzle about reality.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şyndyq tabiğaty turaly jūmbaqtardağy qaişy joramaldardy anyqta.

##### Bölık pen bütınnıñ qatynasyn taldau

[analyzeAPartWholeRelation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/analyzeAPartWholeRelation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether a component and a composite have different identities and what changes follow from replacing parts.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nysan bölıkterınıñ olar qūraityn bütınmen bailanysyn zertte.

##### Sandyq jäne sapalyq bıregeilıktı ajyratu

[distinguishNumericalFromQualitativeIdentity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/distinguishNumericalFromQualitativeIdentity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the difference between being one and the same entity and being indistinguishable in specified properties.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Däl sol bır nysan bolu men tek ūqsas körınudı ajyrat.

##### Özgerıs arqyly bıregeilıktıñ saqtaluyn bağalau

[evaluatePersistenceThroughChange.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/evaluatePersistenceThroughChange.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing criteria for when an object remains the same despite replacement, growth, or alteration.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölşekterdı auystyru nysannyñ bıregeilıgın özgerte me, oilan.

#### Matematikalyq şyndyq

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophical accounts of mathematics disagree over whether its objects exist independently, are constructs of formal language, or are positions within structures. These ontological commitments are distinct from learning to perform mathematical operations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Matematikalyq nysandar adamdardan täuelsız bar ma degen pıkırtalasty zertte.

##### Matematikalyq strukturalizmdı taldau

[analyzeMathematicalStructuralism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/analyzeMathematicalStructuralism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the claim that mathematical objects are understood through positions and relations in structures rather than through individually identifying intrinsic properties.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Matematikalyq nysandardy olardyñ özara bailanystary arqyly tüsıngen dūrys pa, zertte.

##### Matematikalyq nominalizmdı bağalau

[evaluateMathematicalNominalism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/evaluateMathematicalNominalism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine strategies for understanding mathematical language and successful reasoning without committing to independently existing abstract mathematical objects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öz aldyna bar dereksız nysandarsyz matematikalyq oilau qalai mümkın ekenın bağala.

##### Matematikalyq platonizmdı bağalau

[evaluateMathematicalPlatonism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/evaluateMathematicalPlatonism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the view that mathematical objects or structures exist independently of human thought and how it attempts to explain the apparent objectivity of mathematics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Matematikalyq mänder adam sanasynan täuelsız bar degen dälelderdı qarastyr.

### Aqyl-oi, özındık bolmys jäne adam ömır süruı

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about subjective experience, the continuity of the self, deliberate action, and a meaningful human life cannot be resolved solely through psychological measurement. This domain examines theories of mind, identity, agency, and existential commitments, distinguishing them from empirical mental-health claims.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sana, jeke tūlğalyq bıregeilık, erkındık jäne ömır mänı turaly filosofiialyq sūraqtardy zertte.

#### Äreket etu qabıletı jäne erık bostandyğy

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Acting for reasons, selecting among alternatives, and being accountable are connected but separable philosophical ideas.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tañdau, äreket sebepterı jäne jauapkerşılık erkındıkpen qalai bailanysatynyn zertte.

##### Kompatibilizm men inkompatibilizmdegı erkındıktı salystyru

[compareCompatibilistAndIncompatibilistFreedom.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/compareCompatibilistAndIncompatibilistFreedom.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether meaningful free action is possible under determinism and how rival views define freedom.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erkındık pen jauapkerşılık determinizmmen qatar ömır süre ala ma, zertte.

##### Determinizm men indeterminizmdı salystyru

[compareDeterminismAndIndeterminism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/compareDeterminismAndIndeterminism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the different claims about how events are determined and why randomness alone does not establish control.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Barlyğy anyqtalğan älemdı belgısız oqiğalarğa jol beretın älemmen salystyr.

##### Äreket pen oqiğany ajyratu

[distinguishAnActionFromAnEvent.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/distinguishAnActionFromAnEvent.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a description invokes an agent's intention or reason rather than only something that happened to a body.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qasaqana äreket pen jai ğana bolatyn oqiğany ajyrat.

##### Äreket negızdemelerı men mınez-qūlyq sebepterın ajyratu

[distinguishReasonsForActionFromCausesOfBehavior.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/distinguishReasonsForActionFromCausesOfBehavior.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate justifying considerations from causal explanations, recognizing that the two may be related.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärekettı aqtaityn negızdemelerdı mınez-qūlyqty tüsındıretın sebepterden ajyrat.

##### Moraldyq jauapkerşılık şarttaryn bağalau

[evaluateConditionsOfMoralResponsibility.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/evaluateConditionsOfMoralResponsibility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider knowledge, control, intention, and coercion in judging whether blame or praise is warranted.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moraldyq jauapkerşılık üşın qandai bılım men baqylau keregın oilan.

#### Adam bolmysy jäne män

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Existential reflection examines how people understand purpose, authenticity, finitude, and commitments, without prescribing a single life ideal or substituting for mental-health care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mağynaly ärı şynaiy ömır sürudıñ filosofiialyq täsılderın zertte.

##### Şynaiylyqty filosofiialyq ūğym retınde taldau

[analyzeAuthenticityAsAPhilosophicalConcept.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/analyzeAuthenticityAsAPhilosophicalConcept.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate competing claims about acting from one's commitments, social expectations, and self-understanding.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şynaiy äreket etu üşın qoğam ümıtınen täuelsız bolu kerek pe, sony zertte.

##### Ölımdılıktıñ filosofiialyq mañyzyn taldau

[analyzeThePhilosophicalSignificanceOfMortality.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/analyzeThePhilosophicalSignificanceOfMortality.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how finitude affects arguments about priorities and meaning rather than making predictions about an individual's emotional response.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamnyñ ölımdılıgı ömırlık basymdyqtar turaly dälelderge qalai yqpal etetının oilan.

##### Ömır mänı turaly filosofiialyq közqarastardy salystyru

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfMeaningInLife.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfMeaningInLife.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast accounts that ground human meaning in relationships, achievement, self-authorship, transcendence, religious commitments, or nonreligious purposes, assessing their philosophical reasons without requiring adherence to any worldview.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adam ömırıne ne män beretını turaly türlı ideialardy salystyr.

##### Ömırlık maqsat pen ötkınşı qalaudy ajyratu

[distinguishALifePurposeFromAPassingPreference.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/distinguishALifePurposeFromAPassingPreference.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how sustained commitments and values differ from momentary wants when evaluating an account of a meaningful life.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūzaq merzımdı ömırlık mındettemeler men ötkınşı tılekterdı ajyrat.

#### Aqyl-oi men sana

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A first-person experience and a third-person physical description offer different perspectives on mental life. Philosophical theories disagree about how these perspectives relate.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Subektivtı täjıribe men aqyl-oidy tüsınudıñ ärtürlı joldaryn bıl.

##### Jasandy sananyñ filosofiialyq mäselesın taldau

[analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess what would and would not count as evidence of experience in an artificial system, without claiming a settled test exists.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasandy sana turaly tūjyrymdy qandai dälelder qoldai alatynyn oilan.

##### Aqyl-oi men dene qatynasy teoriialaryn salystyru

[compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative views such as physicalism and dualism by their commitments and explanatory challenges.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aqyl-oi men denenıñ bailanysyn tüsındıretın filosofiialyq közqarastardy salystyr.

##### Psihikalyq jäne fizikalyq sipattamalardy ajyratu

[distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim describes subjective experience, observable behavior, or bodily processes, and why they are not automatically equivalent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sezım sipattamalaryn midağy fizikalyq üderıster sipattamalarynan ajyrat.

##### Basqalardyñ sanasy mäselesın tüsındıru

[explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe why another being's subjective experiences are not observed in the same way as one's own, and what kinds of inferences are used.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Basqa tırşılık iesınıñ subektivtı täjıribesı bar ekenın qalai bıluge bolatynyn sūra.

#### Jeke tūlğalyq bıregeilık

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The self may be characterized by bodily, psychological, narrative, or relational continuity. The question is what makes someone the same person, not how memory works empirically.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Uaqyt öte özgerse de, adam qalai sol bır tūlğa bolyp qalatynyn zertte.

##### Tūlğa märtebesınıñ ölşemın taldau

[analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed condition of being a person against borderline cases without assigning anyone lesser real-world dignity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adam qadır-qasietın joqqa şyğarmai, tūlğa märtebesınıñ ölşemderın kürdelı jağdailarda syna.

##### Dene jäne psihologiialyq sabaqtastyq teoriialaryn salystyru

[compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how different criteria handle change, memory loss, and hypothetical transfer scenarios.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūlğalyq bıregeilıktıñ denege jäne psihologiiağa süienetın tūjyrymdaryn salystyr.

##### Tūlğalyq bıregeilık pen ūqsastyqty ajyratu

[distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why sharing a personality or appearance is not enough to establish that two persons are numerically identical.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ekı ūqsas adam mındettı türde bır tūlğa emes ekenın tüsın.

##### Jadtyñ tūlğalyq bıregeilıktegı rölın bağalau

[evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the philosophical significance and limitations of remembered experience as a criterion of persistence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke tūlğanyñ sabaqtastyğyn anyqtau üşın estelıkter jetkılıktı me, sony zertte.

### Filosofiialyq zertteu

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophy investigates conceptual, normative, and foundational questions whose answers require reasons rather than observation alone. This domain concerns the practices used to formulate, refine, and discuss such questions; it is distinct from the formal evaluation of arguments in Logic.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Negızdelgen talqylau arqyly mağyna, qūndylyqtar men boljamdar turaly sūraqtardy zertte.

#### Ūğymdyq taldau

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Careful discussion depends on tracking the boundaries of concepts, especially when ordinary words cover multiple cases. These abilities refine meanings rather than merely memorize technical vocabulary.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Anyq anyqtamalar men oryndy mysaldar filosofiialyq oilaudy qalai jetıldıretının zertte.

##### Dauly ūğymdy naqtylau

[clarifyAContestedConcept.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/clarifyAContestedConcept.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify relevant conditions or uses of a term such as freedom so interlocutors can determine what their disagreement concerns.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdar terminnıñ qoldanyluy jönınde kelıspese, onyñ mağynasyn naqtyla.

##### Qajettı jäne jetkılıktı şarttardy ajyratu

[distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a proposed property is required for a concept to apply, enough for it to apply, or both; a condition can fail one test and pass the other.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şarttyñ qajettı, jetkılıktı, ekeuı de nemese eşqaisysy emes ekenın anyqta.

##### Anyqtamany qarsy mysalmen tekseru

[testADefinitionWithACounterexample.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/testADefinitionWithACounterexample.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a case included or excluded incorrectly by a proposed definition and explain what the case reveals about its limits.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Anyqtama qate sipattaityn jağdaidy tauyp, ony syna.

##### Ūğymdy oişa eksperimentpen zertteu

[useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Vary features of an imagined situation to isolate a philosophical principle; make clear which assumptions are stipulated rather than observed.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İdeiany tekseru üşın oidan şyğarylğan jağdaidy qoldanyp, boljamdaryn anyq körset.

#### Dialog pen kelıspeuşılık

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned dialogue seeks understanding and justified revision, not simply winning assent. Participants must fairly represent alternatives and keep interpersonal respect separate from agreement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Syilastyqpen bıldırılgen kelıspeuşılık oiymyzdy qaita qarauğa qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Tereñdetılgen filosofiialyq sūraq qoiu

[askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Request a reason, distinction, implication, or counterexample that can advance inquiry without demanding personal disclosure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Basqa adamnyñ uäjın tekseretın ne közqarasyn naqtylaityn sūraq qoi.

##### Özgenıñ ūstanymyn ädıl qaita baiandau

[reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Restate an interlocutor's strongest contextually plausible position accurately and charitably, rather than attacking a weaker caricature; fair reconstruction does not require overlooking genuine contradictions or unsupported claims.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Synamas būryn özgenıñ ūstanymyn däl jetkız.

##### Filosofiialyq qarsylyqqa jauap beru

[respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Address the actual challenge to a claim, rather than diverting to the objector's identity or motives.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qarsylyq bıldırgen adamğa tiısudıñ ornyna, qarsylyqtyñ mänıne jauap ber.

##### Dälelderge süienıp ūstanymdy qaita qarau

[reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which premise or conclusion should change when a cogent objection defeats an earlier commitment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küştırek negız tüzetu qajettıgın körsetse, senımdı ne däleldı özgert.

#### Sūraqtar men mäseleler

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A productive philosophical problem can be examined through competing answers, explicit concepts, and reasons. The object is to make a question discussable without assuming that every question has a single empirical test.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tüsınıksız oilardy baiyppen talqylauğa bolatyn sūraqtarğa ainaldyrudy üiren.

##### Filosofiialyq mäselenı mysaldan ajyratu

[distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate the general issue, such as whether promises create obligations, from the particular story used to make it vivid.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jalpy filosofiialyq mäselenı ony körsetetın äñgımeden ajyrat.

##### Filosofiialyq jäne empirikalyq sūraqtardy ajyratu

[distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when an issue asks what a concept means, what ought to be done, or what ultimately explains something, rather than only requesting a measurable fact; many questions have both aspects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Filosofiialyq sūraqtardyñ ölşeu arqyly jauap berıletın sūraqtardan aiyrmasyn tany.

##### Filosofiialyq sūraq qūrastyru

[formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Turn an ordinary puzzlement into an open question about meaning, reasons, values, or assumptions that admits more than a yes-or-no preference.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jai talğam emes, sebep, mağyna nemese qūndylyq turaly aşyq sūraq qoi.

##### Filosofiialyq mäseledegı boljamdardy anyqtau

[identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Expose propositions that a question or proposed answer takes for granted, such as what counts as a person or what makes an action fair.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Filosofiialyq sūraqtyñ ne ūsynylğan jauaptyñ astaryndağy jasyryn boljamdardy tap.

### Tıl filosofiiasy

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Language is examined as a system for conveying meaning, referring to the world, performing actions, and shaping interpretation. Grammar instruction and literary composition remain primarily in Language and Literature.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sözder mağynany qalai jetkızetının, zattardy qalai bıldıretının jäne tüsınıktı qalai qalyptastyratynyn zertte.

#### Qarym-qatynas jäne tüsındıru

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** What a speaker says can differ from what a speaker conveys or does by saying it. Interpretation must take context and plausible alternatives into account.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kontekst adamdardyñ aitqany men jetkızgen mağynasyna qalai äser etetının bıl.

##### Tura mağyna men astardy ajyratu

[distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify content explicitly expressed versus a reasonable conversational inference that could be cancelled or revised.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Pıkırdıñ tura mağynasyn onyñ meñzeitın astarynan ajyrat.

##### Kontekstık tüsındırulerdı bağalau

[evaluateContextualInterpretations.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/evaluateContextualInterpretations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare readings of an utterance using the speaker's context, conventions, and available evidence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kontekst pen qolda bar dälelderdı eskerıp, tüsındıruler arasynan tañda.

##### Söileu aktısın tanu

[identifyASpeechAct.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/identifyASpeechAct.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize how an utterance functions as a promise, request, warning, or assertion beyond its sentence structure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır närsenı aitu uäde beru ne ötınu siiaqty äreketke qaşan ainalatynyn tany.

#### Tıl, aqiqat jäne bilık

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Descriptive categories, framing, and public speech influence which interpretations appear available. Evaluating their justification differs from explaining psychological persuasion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tıldıñ bağalaulardy qalai jetkızıp, qoğamdyq talqylaudy qalai qalyptastyratynyn zertte.

##### Mäselenı ūsynu şeñberın taldau

[analyzeAFramingChoice.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/analyzeAFramingChoice.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternate labels foreground different aspects of one issue and test what evidence each framing leaves out.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır mäselenıñ ärtürlı qyryn körsetetın ataulardy salystyr.

##### Pıkırdıñ aqiqattyq şarttaryn taldau

[analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify circumstances under which an assertion would count as true or false while recognizing context-dependent expressions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qandai jağdaida tūjyrym şyn nemese jalğan bolatynyn anyqta.

##### Sipattau men bağalau tılın ajyratu

[distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how apparently factual wording can also express approval, disapproval, or a contested standard.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Derektei körınetın sözder qaşan bağalaudy da bıldıretının tany.

##### Tıldık beineleu turaly pıkırdı bağalau

[evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a label fairly describes people or phenomena without equating linguistic conventions with objective essences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdar men närselerdı sipattau ädıl ärı jetkılıktı negızdelgen be, qarastyr.

#### Mağyna jäne referentsiia

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Words and sentences can express meanings beyond identifying objects; context, concepts, and the distinction between expression and referent affect analysis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sözdıñ, onyñ mağynasynyñ jäne ol nūsqaityn närsenıñ aiyrmasyn bıl.

##### Söz ben onyñ referentın ajyratu

[distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a linguistic expression and the person, object, or kind it denotes are not identical.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sözdı ol ataityn zattan ne adamnan ajyrat.

##### Män men referentsiiany ajyratu

[distinguishSenseFromReference.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/distinguishSenseFromReference.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how different expressions can pick out the same entity while presenting it in different ways.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı örnekter bır nysandy san aluan jolmen körsete alatynyn tany.

##### Semantikalyq köpmağynalylyqty tanu

[identifySemanticAmbiguity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/identifySemanticAmbiguity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when a sentence admits multiple readings due to a word or syntactic structure rather than simply lacking evidence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bırneşe türlı mağynağa ie boluy mümkın söilemderdı tap.

### Dın filosofiiasy

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned inquiry into religious and nonreligious worldviews considers ultimate explanations, sources of belief, conceptions of divinity, and coexistence under pluralism. This domain evaluates arguments without prescribing worship, faith, atheism, or other personal commitments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qandai da bır senımdı tañbai, dıni jäne dıni emes dünietanymdarğa qatysty dälelderdı zertte.

#### Ärtürlılık jäne män

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Competing outlooks on religion, nonbelief, and life purpose raise interpretive and normative problems. Dialogue must distinguish a disagreement about truth from respect for people's freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dın, senımsızdık jäne ömır mänı jönındegı aiyrmaşylyqtardy qūrmetpen talqylaudy üiren.

##### Dıni pliuralizmdı filosofiialyq mäsele retınde taldau

[analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare accounts of how conflicting ultimate-belief claims might be understood and evaluated while respecting freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bäsekeles dıni aqiqat turaly tūjyrymdarğa filosofiialyq jauaptardy zertte.

##### Dıni tözımdılıktı etikalyq qağida retınde taldau

[analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine justifications and limits for respecting divergent religious or nonreligious commitments, distinguishing toleration from endorsement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özge senımı bar adamdardy qūrmetteudıñ negızderı men şekterın oilan.

##### Dıni skeptitsizm men agnostitsizmdı ajyratu

[distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate withholding belief about particular religious claims from positions on the possibility of knowing whether divine reality exists.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dıni tūjyrymdarğa kümändanu men nenı bıluge bolatyny jönındegı belgısızdıktı ajyrat.

#### Senım, aqyl jäne täjıribe

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different accounts of religious knowledge appeal to reasoning, testimony, revelation, or experience. Philosophical examination weighs what these sources can justify and remains distinct from taking part in a religious practice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senım, paiymdau men täjıribe dıni tūjyrymdardy negızdeu üşın qalai qoldanylatynyn bıl.

##### Senım men aqyldy negızdeu közderı retınde salystyru

[compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze philosophical accounts in which faith and reasoning conflict, complement one another, or play different roles, without assuming one universal religious position.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senım men paiymdau bırın-bırı qalai qoldaityny nemese kümänğa alatyny turaly közqarastardy salystyr.

##### Filosofiialyq ızdenıstı dıni täjıribeden ajyratu

[distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate reasoning about religious claims from performing rituals, accepting revelation, or participating in a tradition.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dıni ideialardy talqylau men dıni räsımderge qatysudyñ aiyrmasyn ajyrat.

##### Aitylğan ğajaiyp turaly tūjyrymdy bağalau

[evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Weigh testimony, background assumptions, and plausible alternative explanations when assessing an extraordinary event claim without prejudging its truth.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kuälıkter men balama tüsındırulerdı salystyra otyryp, erekşe oqiğa turaly tūjyrymdy bağala.

##### Dıni täjıribenı dälel retınde bağalau

[evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the possible warrant of reported transcendent experience, distinguishing the fact of having an experience from the explanation proposed for it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke dıni täjıribe keñırek tūjyrymdy qoldai ma, sony zertte.

#### Tüpkı şyndyq jäne qūdailyq

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Religious and nonreligious accounts of ultimate reality include competing conceptions of divinity and nontheistic accounts of liberation or existence. Their arguments may invoke experience, explanation, definition, or objections, without settling a worldview by stipulation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tüpkı tüsındırmeler men qūdailyqtyñ ärtürlı tüsınıkterıne qatysty dälelderdı qarastyr.

##### Kosmologiialyq däleldı taldau

[analyzeACosmologicalArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/analyzeACosmologicalArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate reasoning from existence, dependence, contingency, or causation toward an ultimate explanation, including challenges to its assumptions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Täueldılık ne sebeptılıkten tüpkı sebeptı şyğaratyn dälelderdı bağala.

##### Jobalau dälelın taldau

[analyzeADesignArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/analyzeADesignArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether order or complexity supports an inference to a designer, considering the evidential relevance of natural alternatives.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kürdelılık nemese tärtıp aqyldy jobalaudyñ dälelı me, sony oilan.

##### Zūlymdyq dälelın taldau

[analyzeAnArgumentFromEvil.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/analyzeAnArgumentFromEvil.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how suffering and wrongdoing challenge particular accounts of divinity and assess the strengths of proposed philosophical responses.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Azap qūdailyq turaly keibır tüsınıkterge qalai kümän tudyratynyn bağala.

##### Ontologiialyq däleldı taldau

[analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate an a priori argument that moves from a proposed concept of God or maximal greatness toward existence, examining whether its logical premises and modal assumptions warrant the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Anyqtamadan qūdailyq bolmysty şyğaruğa tyrysatyn dälelderdı zertte.

##### Şyndyq turaly teistık emes dıni közqarastardy taldau

[analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a particular nontheistic religious tradition understands reality, suffering, liberation, or ultimate truth without incorrectly treating absence of a creator deity as absence of religion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaratuşy qūdaiğa senuge täueldı emes dıni közqarastardy zertte.

##### Qūdailyq turaly filosofiialyq tüsınıkterdı salystyru

[comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish personal, impersonal, and plural conceptions of ultimate reality while recognizing significant diversity within traditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tüpkı şyndyqtyñ tūlğalyq, tūlğalyq emes jäne köptürlı tüsınıkterın salystyr.

##### Ūsynylğan tüpkı tüsındırmenı bağalau

[evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider whether an account of why anything exists explains more than it assumes and what further questions it raises.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bolmysty tüsındıru qanşalyqty köp närsenı tüsındıretının jäne qandai boljamdarğa süienetının sūra.

##### Qūdailyq turaly filosofiialyq däleldı qaita qūru

[reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify premises and conclusion in a theistic, atheistic, or agnostic argument without treating the position as settled by its name.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūdailyqty qoldaityn ne oğan qarsy dälelde keltırılgen negızderdı anyqta.

### Ğylym filosofiiasy

Groups: 4 · Skills: 26

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific inquiry is examined as a way of building, testing, and revising explanations. The focus is on general methodology and evidential justification; physics, biology, psychology, and other sciences own their domain-specific investigations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ğylymi tūjyrymdardy qalai tekserıp, negızdep, qaita qarap, synğa alatynyn zertte.

#### Dälel jäne sebeptık qorytyndy

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observations become informative only through assumptions about measurement, variation, and alternative explanations. The quality of a causal conclusion is not identical to the size of an observed association.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dälel sebep-saldar qatynastary turaly nenı körsete alatynyn jäne nenı körsete almaitynyn zertte.

##### Ölşeu validtılıgın bağalau

[assessMeasurementValidity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/assessMeasurementValidity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an operational measure genuinely captures the construct a researcher claims to study.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ölşeu özı ölşeimın degen närsenı şynymen ölşei me, sony tekser.

##### Irıktemenıñ ökıldıgın bağalau

[assessSampleRepresentativeness.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/assessSampleRepresentativeness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether selection and coverage allow findings to extend to the population named in a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tañdalğan qatysuşylar keñırek halyqty körsete me, sony tekser.

##### Korreliatsiia men sebeptılıktı ajyratu

[distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why two variables varying together does not alone show that changing one produces the other.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ekı ainymaly bırge özgerse, bıreuı ekınşısın tudyrady degen söz emes.

##### Zertteudıñ sebeptık qorytyndysyn bağalau

[evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how design, alternative explanations, limitations, and observed evidence jointly support or weaken a causal claim.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sebep turaly tūjyrymdy zertteu jobasy, dälelder jäne balama tüsındırmeler arqyly bağala.

##### Irıkteu belgısızdıgın bağalau

[evaluateSamplingUncertainty.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/evaluateSamplingUncertainty.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how sample size, observed variation, and sampling processes affect the precision of an estimate, distinguishing imprecision from whether the sample represents its target population.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Irıkteu täsılı men özgergıştık bağalau däldıgıne qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Şatastyruşy faktordy anyqtau

[identifyAConfoundingFactor.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/identifyAConfoundingFactor.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a plausible third variable or selection process capable of producing an apparent relationship.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baiqalğan bailanysty tüsındıruı mümkın üşınşı faktordy tap.

#### Eksperimenttı josparlau

Skills: 9

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Controlled investigations attempt to isolate explanatory factors while managing confounding, expectations, and ethical constraints. Particular safeguards solve different problems and are not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zertteu jobasy salystyrulardy qalai senımdırek etetının zertte.

##### Mañyzdy eksperiment jağdailaryn baqylau

[controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Hold relevant background conditions stable or account for them so comparisons are not undermined by extraneous differences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ädıl salystyru üşın mañyzdy syrtqy jağdailardy bırdei saqta.

##### Zertteu etikasyn bağalau

[evaluateResearchEthics.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/evaluateResearchEthics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess informed consent, voluntary participation, proportionality of risk, participant protection, and integrity of reporting in proposed research; distinguish ethical permissibility from whether a study can yield valid data.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūsynylğan zertteudı bağalağanda kelısım, qauıpsızdık jäne şynaiy eseptı esker.

##### Platsebo baqylauyn tüsındıru

[explainAPlaceboControl.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/explainAPlaceboControl.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a comparison intended to account for expectations or contextual effects from an active treatment or mere absence of intervention.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Platsebomen salystyru emnıñ äserın kütu äserınen ajyratuğa qalai kömektesetının tüsın.

##### Ekıjaqty soqyrlau ädısın tüsındıru

[explainDoubleBlinding.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/explainDoubleBlinding.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when both participants and interacting researchers or outcome assessors are kept unaware of allocation, and why such a design is neither always feasible nor universally required.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qatysuşylar da, zertteuşıler de topqa bölınudı bılmese, keibır auytqular qalai azaiatynyn zertte.

##### Kezdeisoq tağaiyndaudy tüsındıru

[explainRandomAssignment.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/explainRandomAssignment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show how allocating participants or units by chance can reduce systematic pre-existing differences between comparison groups.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Toptarğa kezdeisoq böludıñ bastapqy aiyrmaşylyqtardy qalai azaitatynyn tüsındır.

##### Bırjaqty soqyrlau ädısın tüsındıru

[explainSingleBlinding.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/explainSingleBlinding.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which party is kept unaware of assigned conditions and how that may reduce particular expectation-related effects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır taraptan tağaiyndalğan şartty jasyru kütu äserın qalai azaitatynyn tüsın.

##### Baqylau tobynyñ maqsatyn tüsındıru

[explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the comparison condition needed to interpret an intervention's effect where a control group is appropriate.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baqylau toby aralasudyñ äserın jeke anyqtauğa qalai kömektesetının tüsın.

##### Täueldı ainymalyny anyqtau

[identifyADependentVariable.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/identifyADependentVariable.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the measured response or outcome whose variation an investigation attempts to account for, distinguishing outcome measurement from factors that may influence it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zertteude nätije retınde ne ölşenetının anyqta.

##### Täuelsız ainymalyny anyqtau

[identifyAnIndependentVariable.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/identifyAnIndependentVariable.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the hypothesized influence, manipulated factor, or explanatory predictor in a specified study, including designs where the researcher observes rather than sets its value.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zertteu nätijesıne äser etedı dep boljanğan faktordy tap.

#### Sūraqtar men gipotezalar

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Research design starts with propositions that can be addressed using evidence. Questions, hypotheses, predictions, and observation serve different epistemic roles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zertteu sūrağy, gipoteza, boljam jäne baqylau aiyrmasyn bıl.

##### Baqylau jäne eksperimenttık zertteulerdı salystyru

[compareObservationalAndExperimentalResearch.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/compareObservationalAndExperimentalResearch.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish observing variation as it occurs from deliberately manipulating an explanatory factor.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tabiği özgerıstı baqylau men bır faktordy ädeiı özgertudı ajyrat.

##### Gipotezadan boljam şyğaru

[deriveAPredictionFromAHypothesis.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/deriveAPredictionFromAHypothesis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain what should be observed under specified conditions if a proposed explanation is correct.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gipoteza dūrys bolsa, belgılı jağdaida ne boluğa tiıs ekenın bolja.

##### Baqylaudy tüsındıruden ajyratu

[distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a recorded outcome from the theory-dependent explanation assigned to that outcome.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tırkelgen närsenı onyñ qalai tüsındırılgenınen ajyrat.

##### Tekserıletın gipoteza tūjyrymdau

[formulateATestableHypothesis.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/formulateATestableHypothesis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a possible answer whose empirical implications can be investigated rather than relying on an unfalsifiable restatement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baqylaular arqyly synauğa bolatyn tüsındırme ūsyn.

##### Empirikalyq zertteletın sūraq qūrastyru

[formulateAnEmpiricallyInvestigableQuestion.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/formulateAnEmpiricallyInvestigableQuestion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify observations or comparisons that could bear on a precise research question, while recognizing questions outside empirical testing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tiıstı dälelder kömegımen zertteuge bolatyn sūraq qoi.

#### Teoriialar jäne ğylymi täjıribe

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific conclusions are provisional but not arbitrary: shared procedures, criticism, reproducibility, and explanatory success distinguish responsible inquiry from mere assertion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Syn men jaña dälelder ğylymi teoriialardy qalai jetıldıretının zertte.

##### Ğylymi teoriia men gipotezany ajyratu

[distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a theory as a broad explanatory framework supported and refined through inquiry, not merely an untested guess.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keñ auqymda tekserılgen ğylymi teoriiany jeke gipotezadan ajyrat.

##### Ğylymi retsenziialaudy bağalau

[evaluateScientificPeerReview.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/evaluateScientificPeerReview.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish expert scrutiny of methods and interpretation from a guarantee that published claims are correct.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ğylymi jūmysty sarapşylar bağalauynyñ paidasy men şekteulerın tüsın.

##### Tūjyrymnyñ terıstelu mümkındıgın bağalau

[evaluateTheFalsifiabilityOfAClaim.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/evaluateTheFalsifiabilityOfAClaim.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether plausible observations could count against a proposition without treating falsifiability as the sole criterion of science.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qai baqylaular ğylymi tūjyrymğa qarsy dälel bola alatynyn sūra.

##### Ğylymnyñ özın-özı tüzetuın tüsındıru

[explainScientificSelfCorrection.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/explainScientificSelfCorrection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how independent criticism and new evidence can revise established models, without equating uncertainty with lack of knowledge.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaña dälel ğylymdy būrynğy qorytyndylardy qaita qarauğa qalai jeteleitının tüsındır.

##### Zertteudı qaitalaudyñ rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfReplication.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/explainTheRoleOfReplication.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show why repeating an investigation can expose chance results, context dependence, or methodological errors.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zertteudı qaitalau nätijelerdı tekseruge nege kömektesetının tüsın.

##### Zertteudegı müddeler qaqtyğysyn anyqtau

[identifyConflictsOfInterestInResearch.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/identifyConflictsOfInterestInResearch.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize relationships that may create incentives to bias design, interpretation, or publication without assuming misconduct.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zertteu jürgızu ne nätijesın habarlauğa äser etuı mümkın bailanystardy baiqa.

### Äleumettık jäne saiasi filosofiia

Groups: 6 · Skills: 23

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Political and social philosophy examines the justification of collective rules, institutions, authority, rights, and distributions of benefits and burdens. It asks normative questions rather than describing the chronology of regimes or the mechanics of markets.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zañdar, qūqyqtar, bilık jäne ortaq qoğamdyq şeşımderdıñ moraldyq negızderın zertte.

#### Ädılettılık pen teñdık

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Claims of fairness depend on what is distributed, who qualifies for consideration, and which differences are morally relevant.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ädıldık turaly ärtürlı tüsınıkter qoğamdyq qūrylysty qalai qalyptastyratynyn zertte.

##### Protseduralyq ädıldıktı taldau

[analyzeProceduralFairness.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/analyzeProceduralFairness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the transparency, consistency, and opportunity to contest a decision independent of who benefits from its outcome.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nätijesı dauly bolsa da, şeşım qabyldau üderısı ädıl ötkenın bağala.

##### Bölu qağidalaryn salystyru

[compareDistributivePrinciples.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/compareDistributivePrinciples.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate allocation by need, merit, equality, entitlement, or sufficiency and identify conflicts between principles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Resurstar qajettılık, eñbek sıñıru, qūqyq ne teñdık boiynşa bölınuı tiıs pe, bağala.

##### Teñdık pen ädıl eskerudı ajyratu

[distinguishEqualityFromEquity.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/distinguishEqualityFromEquity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare giving identical treatment with responding to relevant differences in needs or disadvantage, without assuming one always settles justice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Barşağa bırdei qarau men mañyzdy aiyrmaşylyqtardy eskerudı salystyr.

##### Kemsıtu turaly pıkırdı bağalau

[evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether a distinction in treatment is relevantly justified or imposes an unfair burden on a protected or vulnerable group.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı qarau oryndy ma, älde kemsıtu me, sony tekser.

#### Qūqyq filosofiiasy

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Jurisprudence considers what makes a norm legally valid, why legal institutions claim authority, and how rules should be interpreted. These questions are not limited to any country's current statutes or to political legitimacy in general.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūqyqtyq normalarğa bedeldı ne beretının jäne olardy qalai tüsındıru kerektıgın zertte.

##### Qūqyqtyq pozitivizmdı taldau

[analyzeLegalPositivism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/analyzeLegalPositivism.ts)

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūqyqtyñ jaramdylyğy moraldyq qūndylyğyna emes, äleumettık bastaularyna täueldı degen pıkırdı zertte.

##### Tabiği qūqyq teoriiasyn taldau

[analyzeNaturalLawTheory.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/analyzeNaturalLawTheory.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate theories that understand legal authority or validity as importantly connected to morality, distinguishing different versions of this connection.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūqyq bedelın moraldyq qağidalarmen bailanystyratyn közqarastardy salystyr.

##### Qūqyq üstemdıgın taldau

[analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine principles such as generality, accessibility, prospectivity, consistent application, and constraints on arbitrary power as grounds for evaluating a legal order.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zañdardy aşyq ärı boljamdy etıp, ozbyr bilıktı şekteitın qağidalardy zertte.

##### Qūqyqty tüsındıru teoriialaryn bağalau

[evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how text, legislative purpose, precedent, and institutional role support competing interpretations of a legal provision without deciding a real legal dispute.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mätın, maqsat jäne sot pretsedentterı qūqyqtyq normany tüsındıruge qalai yqpal etetının qarastyr.

#### Saiasi bilık

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Institutions exercise collective power that requires justification. Political legitimacy, coercion, and obedience are distinct concepts.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Saiasi bilıktı jai küştı emes, zañdy ärı oryndy etetın ne ekenın zertte.

##### Azamattyq bağynbaudy taldau

[analyzeCivilDisobedience.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/analyzeCivilDisobedience.ts)
