##### Qoğamdyq kelısım dälelderın salystyru

[compareSocialContractArguments.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/compareSocialContractArguments.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternative accounts use consent, cooperation, security, or fairness to justify political obligations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qoğamdyq instituttardyñ ereje ornatu qūqyğyn negızdeitın dälelderdı bağala.

##### Saiasi bilıktıñ zañdylyğyn bağalau

[evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine reasons offered to justify the right to make binding public decisions, not merely whether an institution controls force.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ükımettı kelısım, qauıpsızdık ne yntymaqtastyq arqyly aqtaityn dälelderdı salystyr.

##### Memlekettık mäjbürleu şegın bağalau

[evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing grounds for restricting individual actions, such as preventing harm or protecting rights.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke bostandyqty şekteu qaşan oryndy boluy mümkın ekenın qarastyr.

#### Qoğamdyq aqyl jäne azamattyq ömır

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** People with incompatible values must still make shared decisions. Philosophical inquiry examines how disagreements can be handled under pluralism and institutional accountability.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūndylyqtary ärtürlı adamdar barşağa äser etetın şeşımderdı qalai negızdeitının bıl.

##### Demokratiialyq zañdylyqty taldau

[analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the roles of participation, representation, minority protections, and accountability in justifying collective decisions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qatysu, ökıldık pen eseptılık demokratiiany qalai negızdeitının qarastyr.

##### Ortaq igılık turaly däleldı bağalau

[assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine who benefits, who bears costs, and whether a proposed collective interest disregards legitimate dissent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ortaq igılık jaily pıkır kımnıñ müddesın bıldıretının tekser.

##### Qoğamdyq dälel men jeke qalaudy ajyratu

[distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify justifications aimed at principles others can evaluate, rather than asserting that a personal desire must settle collective policy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ortaq talqylauğa bolatyn negızdemelerdı özgeler bölısuge mındettı emes jeke qalaudan ajyrat.

##### Saiasi mındet turaly közqarastardy bağalau

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider when citizens may have moral reasons to obey, criticize, or resist laws irrespective of mere fear of punishment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdardyñ zañdardy nege ūstanatynyn, synaitynyn nemese qarsy tūratynyn zertte.

#### Qūqyqtar men bostandyq

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdar qandai qūqyqtaryn talap ete alatynyn jäne bostandyq nenı bıldıretının zertte.

##### Qūqyqtar qaişylyğyn taldau

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mañyzdy qūqyqtar qaqtyğysyn qalai şeşuge bolatynyn qarastyr.

##### Terıs jäne oñ bostandyqty ajyratu

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aralasudan azat boludy tiımdı äreket etu qabıletımen salystyr.

##### Qūqyq pen artyqşylyqty ajyratu

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamğa tiesılı qūqyqty şartpen berıletın artyqşylyqtan ajyrat.

##### Ar-ojdan bostandyğyn tüsındıru

[explainFreedomOfConscience.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/explainFreedomOfConscience.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdar dıni nemese dıni emes nanymdardy nege erkın ūstanuy kerektıgın zertte.

#### Tehnologiia jäne qoğam

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tehnologiialardyñ adam äreketterı men qoğamğa qalai äser etetının taldaudy üiren.

##### Tehnologiialyq jüielerdegı adam derbestıgın taldau

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tehnologiia adamnyñ öz şeşımderın baqylauyn qaşan küşeitıp ne şekteitının zertte.

##### Tehnologiialyq deldaldyqty taldau

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tehnologiia adamdardyñ tañdau mümkındıkterı men qatynastaryn qalai özgertetının zertte.

##### Tehnologiialyq determinizmdı bağalau

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qoğam damuyn tek tehnologiialyq özgerıs anyqtai ma degen sūraq qoi.
